mathematical_meanings: Left image: The oval represents the circular rim of the upper face of a cylinder in perspective. Right image: The oval is the ellipse marked with semiaxes along the coordinate axes.
Rationales: The feature shows a circular rim of a solid in perspective in the left image and traces a plane ellipse on the axes in the right image. The continuous oval at the upper end of the cylinder. The plane oval through A1 at x = 4 and A2 at x = −4.
